warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h persist across alpine areas above 1900 metres this afternoon, easing slightly later in the evening. Winds will strengthen again before sunrise on Thursday morning and will persist for most of the day. Winds will eventually ease below warning thresholds during Thursday evening. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station.
